plugins.name: westland
plugins.description: Westland organizational plugin — safety hooks, house-style references, and bug-report capture. Install first; required dependency of domain plugins. Contains the Westland Project Files PreToolUse hook (modify-prompt on existing files; .xer in-place changes/deletes denied; .html/.md/.json allowlisted), the westland-house-style skill, and the westland-bug-report skill (Procore-gated bug capture to Supabase via the Westland MCP connector).

plugins.name: scheduling
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction scheduling — Westland standards, P6 XER operations, proposal schedules with self-contained Gantt review HTML + Copy-for-Claude iteration loop, reviewer-feedback download (attribution-tagged JSON), Tier 3 XER modification + generation (validate_xer_structure, apply_xer_changes, fix_duplicate_activity_ids, create_xer_from_template), a WBS-pathed activity roster + adjacency read surface (list_activities, get_activity, get_wbs_branch, next_free_activity_code), name-based Responsibility (trade) code assignment (suggest_responsibility + set_responsibility, backed by a remembered global code list) with a reasoned per-activity workflow in the schedule-assign-responsibility skill, and a single propsched dispatcher (iterate, paths, anchors, diff, score, aggregate-postmortems, durations).

plugins.name: estimating
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction estimating — bid reviews, scope gap analysis, and bid leveling.

plugins.name: construction
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for the construction phase — Procore-native workflows plus a Procore MCP toolkit. Read project dashboards, review and grade daily logs, snapshot RFI/submittal health, chase overdue responses, batch-import observations from field reports, log manpower/calls/correspondence, review submittals against specs, distribute change events, and write RFIs — all with dry-run write safety. Merges the former project-management and site-operations plugins.

plugins.name: safety
